preparations.execution_note: Set up the next station during recovery. Budget includes ramps and light pair rehearsal; if not ready, extend preparation and record that fact rather than rush or cut approved working sets. Full-session timing is an estimate, not a fixed sum or a new tempo.
preparations.ramp_guidance: After the circuit, perform 2–3 short squat ramp sets: empty bar or very light × 8; add load × 5; if useful, a final heavier × 2–3. Work towards, never above, the planned first working load; each ramp feels comfortable with several reps spare. Use about 30–60 s to change load/recover, then 60–90 s before the first working set. If the working load is light, omit the unnecessary heavier ramp. Working sets still rest 150–180 s.

preparations.execution_note: Set up the next station during recovery. Budget includes ramps and light pair rehearsal; if not ready, extend preparation and record that fact rather than rush or cut approved working sets. Full-session timing is an estimate, not a fixed sum or a new tempo.
preparations.ramp_guidance: Perform two RDL ramp sets: very light × 8, then a moderate load × 5, both comfortably short of fatigue; rest about 30–60 s while changing load. Choose by feel and hinge control, not a squat benchmark. Before the first press/row pair, take one brief easy rehearsal of each if needed; this is preparation, not another working pair.

preparations.ramp_guidance: Perform two front-rack reverse-lunge ramp sets: light dumbbells × 4 per leg, then a moderate pair × 2 per leg, with about 30–60 s to recover/change load. Keep balance and the front rack comfortable. Choose loads by feel, never a squat benchmark. Before the first press/row pair, take one brief easy rehearsal if needed.

preparations.execution_note: Ten-minute easy run + two-minute dynamic circuit + 2 min 20 s accelerations = 14 min 20 s, plus 40–160 s transitions. Main work and authored 15–20 min easy cooldown plus 5 min walking remain unchanged.
preparations.new_dynamic_sequence: One relaxed circuit: 8 bodyweight squats, 6 bodyweight reverse lunges per leg, 8 unloaded hip hinges. Keep moving and use the remainder of two minutes for easy walking/jogging; no stretching into discomfort.
